description: Quarantined flaky tests. Each one has an open issue that owns its fix, a reason, and an expiry at most 30 days ahead. The blocking test runs leave these tests out, and a non-blocking CI step runs each one 3 times and reports. check-flaky-tests fails on an expired entry, on a missing or done issue, and on a name that is not in the file. See docs/contributing/testing.md#flaky-tests.

tests.name: a schema change with no migration fails, and passes once drizzle-kit writes one
tests.reason: Five real drizzle-kit runs hit the 5 s test timeout on a loaded CI runner (CI run 41198473156, PR #109). It passed on the rerun.
